name: Starlight Princess Pachi

features.name: Scatter Respin
features.description: A middle-reel scatter holds while other reels respin.

review:
Starlight Princess Pachi is a fast 3x3 entry in the Starlight Princess series, with 27 ways to win. The blue star is the most valuable symbol.

If a princess scatter lands only on the middle reel, the Scatter Respin holds it while the other reels spin. Three scatters launch free spins, which begin with a respin mini-game that sets how many spins you start with, and scatters keep being collected during the bonus. The RTP is 96.04%. Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a max win on the page. A compact, pachinko-inspired variation.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
